author: armster15
body:
# Why
The `<Header />` component is a highly dynamic component that contains a lot of state logic. However, when navigating across pages, the website currently resets the state. This is most evident when you click the bunny, which changes it to something else, but then navigate to another page, upon which the bunny is reset to the original image.

By moving the Header component to `_app.tsx`, the component is not re-rendered from scratch during a page navigation, preserving the state of the component.

This PR also avoids the use of passing a `currentRoute` prop in favor of using the `pathname` property directly from the `useRouter` hook to reduce complexity as well as to prevent state from resetting.

See https://nextjs.org/docs/pages/building-your-application/routing/pages-and-layouts#examples for more information.

This PR introduces significant improvements to the betting system architecture and player management, focusing on better separation of concerns, enhanced testability, and more robust game state handling.

## Key Changes

### 1. Betting System Refactor (`game/betting.py`)
- Split `betting_round` into two specialized functions:
  - `handle_betting_round`: New main entry point for betting round management
  - `betting_round`: Focused on core betting mechanics
- Improved input validation and game state management
- Enhanced side pot creation logic
- Streamlined betting process flow

### 2. Player Queue Management (`player_queue.py`)
- Added new PlayerQueue class with comprehensive player state tracking
- Implemented new methods for player management:
  - `_update_player_lists`
  - `get_active_count`
  - `get_all_in_count`
  - `get_folded_count`
  - `mark_player_acted`
  - `reset_action_tracking`
  - `all_players_acted`
- Enhanced round completion logic considering active and all-in players

### 3. Testing Infrastructure (`tests/`)
- Added comprehensive fixture categories:
  - Player management fixtures
  - Game state fixtures
  - Betting component fixtures
  - Player queue management fixtures
  - AI/strategy component fixtures
  - Utility fixtures
- Implemented MockPlayer class with improved comparison logic
- Enhanced MockPlayerQueue for better testing capabilities
- Added extensive test coverage for betting scenarios

### 4. Game Logic Updates (`game.py`)
- Simplified pot management in betting rounds
- Streamlined return values from betting rounds
- Improved handling of game state transitions

## Testing
- Added comprehensive test suite for betting scenarios
- Enhanced player queue testing with detailed verification steps
- Improved test coverage for edge cases and complex scenarios

## Technical Debt Addressed
- Removed redundant code in betting round handling
- Improved separation of concerns in betting logic
- Enhanced code organization and maintainability
- Better encapsulation of player state management

## Impact
These changes provide:
1. More maintainable and testable betting system
2. Robust player state management
3. Clearer separation of concerns
4. Improved handling of complex betting scenarios
5. Better support for future feature additions

author: khuey
body: Support (or lack thereof) for 56 bit addresses is a trace portability hazard that we want to detect up front. We record whether or not 5 level paging was used in the trace, which is trivially observable from the addresses that pass through AddressSpace::map. Then during replay of a trace that uses 5 level paging we attempt to map something above the standard 47 bit address space, and if it fails, we die with a useful error message.

author: mayanksoni1996
body:
This pull request introduces several new DTOs, controllers, and data management implementations, as well as some refactoring to consolidate data management classes. The most important changes include the addition of new DTOs for creating directory groups and role mappings, new controllers for handling group and role-related requests, and a new data manager implementation for handling group and role data in MongoDB.

### New DTOs:
* `CreateDirectoryGroup` and `CreateRoleMappingWithGroup` classes have been added to the `com.heimdallauth.server.commons.dto.kratos` package. These classes use Lombok annotations for boilerplate code reduction. [[1]](diffhunk://#diff-6ddaddf327c07f8344a805239baca1130062bf813146179d95ea8029e2cba4d5R1-R13) [[2]](diffhunk://#diff-25e8edbfb3e67fc222243abef875b0ea3d3447e1823d6b77cedbbe747e5224abR1-R15)

### New Controllers:
* `GroupController` and `RoleController` have been added to the `com.heimdallauth.server.controller.v1` package. These controllers provide endpoints for creating, retrieving, and updating groups and roles. [[1]](diffhunk://#diff-7c862fb9587618ab1a8f4cf826ce266543ad83d79934023079ed84cd8c027743R1-R39) [[2]](diffhunk://#diff-48f62503022395fda6666939f31b25a1cfbffafe4021247109ca22311ebefff3R1-R31)

### New Data Management Implementations:
* `GroupRoleDataManagerMongoImpl` class has been added to handle MongoDB operations for groups and roles. This class consolidates the functionalities of the removed `GroupsMongoDataManager` and `RoleDataManagerMongoImpl` classes. [[1]](diffhunk://#diff-9857ef85abff67ebbd9fdbc1d04481618deff41d63581c5702bc794b45e94373R1-R225) [[2]](diffhunk://#diff-2473867143e2c4272e59674850f6c645bb7cbfb970bba990abe8a58dcdeabac9L1-L118) [[3]](diffhunk://#diff-4e06ac1730b762ce9a9ec5e5573bf128ddc475faf4ac7246b3685a807c2b1b5cL1-L70)

### Configuration Changes:
* `HeimdallTenantConfiguration` class has been added to the `com.heimdallauth.server.config` package and is enabled in the `KratosApplication` class. This class handles tenant-related configuration properties. [[1]](diffhunk://#diff-455342b5201286027e569aa53154d0ff8b1526bdee8ab4ecd8b62f4e7e25ecdeR1-R20) [[2]](diffhunk://#diff-486a3f05e02c2171b8ffa80663abb886617d6677b7b1878f9ec2a6b6968d8967R3-R9)

### New Data Models:
* `GroupRoleMembershipDocument` class has been added to represent group-role membership documents in MongoDB. This class uses Lombok annotations for boilerplate code reduction.
